name: Insider override of credit policy or unusual speed of approval
description: Staff-approved exceptions or rapid decisions with limited verification.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

links.name: Insider override of credit policy or unusual speed of approval
links.ctx: Credit, onboarding or exception approvals are pushed through unusually fast by the same employee, with thin verification, for connected customers.
